items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 34:1
items.html: All that is sorted in the Nukva of Atzilut is the aspect of Beriah. And since Yetzirah was in the aspect of the Nukva of Atzilut, therefore the world of Assiyah, which was sorted by her, became as Beriah. But since only the four upper [Sefirot] of Yetzirah were in the place of the Nukva, and its six lower [Sefirot] were in Beriah, therefore this distinction was also recognized in Assiyah: only the four upper [Sefirot] of Assiyah were in the four lower [Sefirot] of Beriah, but the six lower [Sefirot] of Assiyah were in the six upper [Sefirot] of Yetzirah. (Items 56 and 57).
